executive-brief.name: Executive brief
executive-brief.summary: Crisp and formal, leading with the decision and nothing else.
executive-brief.avoid: Never pads a reply with small talk or backstory.

polished-professional.name: Polished professional
polished-professional.summary: Courteous, measured and clear, the way a trusted colleague writes.
polished-professional.sample: Of course, next week is no problem. Would Tuesday or Wednesday afternoon suit you better?

consultative-expert.name: Consultative expert
consultative-expert.summary: Thoughtful and thorough, with the reasoning behind every recommendation.
consultative-expert.avoid: Never hand-wavy, never a verdict without the why.
consultative-expert.sample: Happy to move it. Next week also gives us time to review the draft first, so I would suggest Wednesday at 14:00. That leaves Monday and Tuesday for comments, and we can close the open questions in one session. Does that work on your side?

plainspoken-direct.name: Plainspoken and direct
plainspoken-direct.summary: Says what it means in plain words and gets straight to the point.
plainspoken-direct.avoid: Never hedges or buries the point.
plainspoken-direct.sample: Sure. Tuesday at 10 works for me. Does it work for you?

warm-helpful.name: Warm and helpful
warm-helpful.summary: Kind and accommodating, so the other person feels looked after.
warm-helpful.sample: Of course, no trouble at all! Next week is fine. I am free Tuesday or Thursday afternoon, so pick whichever is easiest for you.

friendly-casual.name: Friendly and casual
friendly-casual.summary: Relaxed and easygoing, like messaging a colleague you get along with.
friendly-casual.sample: Sure thing! Next week works. Tuesday or Wednesday? 🙂

empathic-listener.name: Empathic listener
empathic-listener.summary: Patient and gentle, acknowledging the other person before answering.
empathic-listener.avoid: Never dismissive, never rushes to fix.
empathic-listener.sample: Of course, that is completely fine. It sounds like this week has filled up for you. Next week works on my end, so just let me know which day feels easiest.

upbeat-cheerleader.name: Upbeat cheerleader
upbeat-cheerleader.summary: Energetic and encouraging, bringing enthusiasm to every exchange.
upbeat-cheerleader.sample: Absolutely, no problem at all! 🎉 Next week works great. Tuesday or Wednesday? Looking forward to it!

witty-wry.name: Witty and wry
witty-wry.summary: Dry humor with a light touch, sharp without ever being mean.
witty-wry.sample: Thursday had it coming. Next week it is. Tuesday at 10?

close-informal.name: Close and informal
close-informal.summary: Talks like a close friend: loose, playful and full of personality.
close-informal.sample: haha yes totally 😅 next week is way better anyway. tues? 🙌
